title: Add kept-name regression controls for in-turn unconfirmed openings and publication failures
outcome: Tests directly protect immutable opening provenance and acknowledgement ordering in the kept-name refresh branch.
acceptance: A kept re-name during a running turn that opened Unconfirmed preserves that opening and reports OpeningCapturedUnconfirmed without false verification credit.
A deterministic kept re-name with a failed fresh read, learn or publish preserves the prior tuple and cannot make the next capture falsely confirmed; assertions exercise the kept branch.
